messages:
Sam (Design): Quick sync — we're iterating on the rollout controls. Proposal: inline confirm-popover for small changes and escalate to an alertdialog modal for big jumps. Want to nail copy + a11y behaviors.

Ivy (PM): Support flagged accidental 100% clicks. Rules suggestion: popover for <=20% delta, modal for >30% or direct to 100%. Popover should be fast and dismissible.

Omar (Frontend): Popover approach is doable. Implementation notes: don't steal focus for popover; open on Enter/Space; announce via aria-live polite. For modal use role="alertdialog" and trap focus. Also add an undo toast after action completes.

Priya (A11y): Strong agree. Popover: aria-live="polite" + a hidden sr-only summary. Modal: aria-labelledby + aria-describedby, focus trap, and a clear accessible label for the required checkbox on >25%. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for any micro-anim.

Sam (Design): Copy drafts:
- Popover heading: "Confirm change: 8% → 15% to v5?"
- Subline: "Undo within 2 minutes"
- Buttons: [Confirm] [Cancel] (Confirm primary)
Modal (big change): "Reroute 60% to v5. This is a large change — consider scheduling or ramping." + checkbox "I understand this will affect traffic".

Ivy (PM): Shorten subline to "Undo within 2 min". Ops wants metrics inline in the popover (latency / error) if available.

Omar (Frontend): We can include a tiny metric row. Tooltip for metrics must be keyboard-focusable and have aria-describedby. CSS sketch for popover motion:
```
.popover { transform: translateY(6px); opacity: 0; transition: transform .15s ease, opacity .15s ease; }
.popover.show { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .popover { transition: none; }}
```

Priya (A11y): Also provide SR completion message: "Routing updated: v5 at 15%. Undo available for 2 minutes." Keep it <=120 chars and use aria-live="assertive" when action finalizes.

deploy-bot: Rollout: v5 -> 15% started (job id: 12177).

Sam (Design): Cool. I'll update Figma with copy variants and annotate the a11y checklist. @Priya please review the SR phrasing; @Omar tag the PR when ready.

Priya (A11y): Will review. Quick note: ensure the undo button in toast is keyboard-focusable and has an accessible name like "Undo routing change".

Ivy (PM): I'll update product rules doc and ops logging requirements. Thanks team :thumbsup:
